description: Helper functions and constants for interacting with EconDB API, including data retrieval, parsing, and JSON file updates.

methods.name: parse_symbols
methods.description: Constructs indicator symbols with optional transformations and countries.

methods.name: unit_multiplier
methods.description: Returns numeric multiplier based on unit string.

methods.name: get_indicator_countries
methods.description: Retrieves list of countries for a given indicator.

methods.name: create_token
methods.description: Creates a temporary API token for EconDB, optionally using cache.

methods.name: download_indicators
methods.description: Downloads main indicator list from EconDB and processes it.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Fetches data context for a symbol and countries, with caching.

methods.name: parse_context
methods.description: Parses the response from get_context into DataFrame and metadata.

methods.name: update_json_files
methods.description: Updates static JSON files with latest indicator data from EconDB.
